description: Congregation Mikveh Israel, a historic Philadelphia synagogue, was struck by arson and vandalism. Police released video of suspects attempting to break through a fence and door.
Two Jewish DePaul University students, Max Long and Michael Kaminsky, said they were punched by masked attackers while showing support for Israel outside the DePaul Student Center in Lincoln Park.
Two swastikas were spray-painted at the entrance to Temple Israel in Minneapolis.

Israeli Embassy staff members Yaron Lischinsky and Sarah Milgrim were shot and killed outside the Capital Jewish Museum after leaving an American Jewish Committee event. Suspect Elias Rodriguez was charged with murder, murder of foreign officials, and firearms offenses; the killings are being investigated as a hate crime and act of terrorism.

A man used a makeshift flamethrower and Molotov cocktails to attack participants in a solidarity walk for Israeli hostages in downtown Boulder. State prosecutors identified 29 victims; 13 were physically injured, and an 82-year-old woman injured in the attack later died. Suspect Mohamed Sabry Soliman faces state and federal hate crime charges.

The rubble of the Pasadena Jewish Temple and Center, destroyed a year earlier in the Eaton Fire, was vandalized with anti-Zionist graffiti. LA County sheriff's deputies opened a hate crime investigation; no suspect has been named.
